label: 转换工作台
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one high fidelity PixelForge desktop image conversion WORKSPACE design preview, edge-to-edge at a wide desktop viewport with no browser frame. It is the functional screen reached after the introduction homepage. Preserve the identity of the attached real existing workspace screenshot: sage off-white, forest-green action controls, clear dark green text, quiet borders, system Chinese text and compact precise tools. Refine the actual operations screen, do not turn it into marketing. Header PixelForge wordmark and navigation “首页 / 转换工作台 / 格式支持 / 使用指南”, with 转换工作台 active. Small page heading “转换工作台”, supporting text “添加图片，选好格式后开始转换。” Below, a dominant large image comparison area on the left and compact settings on the right. In the comparison, one landscape image is identical on both sides except plausible subtle encoding; labels “原图” / “转换结果”, centered drag handle. No fake colors changing, no file sizes or compression claims. The image is explicitly “示例图片”. Beneath it, a queue with two image filenames 示例-山景.png and 示例-叶片.png, each “已完成”, individual download and remove buttons, then “添加图片”. Settings include target output buttons JPG, PNG, WebP selected, AVIF, GIF, TIFF, BMP, ICO and a “更多格式” control; “画质” adjustable slider; width and height optional numeric fields with text “留空保持原尺寸，只缩小、不放大”; checkbox “移除元数据” with help “也会移除 ICC 色彩配置”; strong main button “转换全部图片”. At bottom a clearly actionable “下载 ZIP” beside a short completion message “2 张图片已转换”. Footer explicitly and legibly says “仅处理静态图片。HEIC / HEIF 仅支持导入；PSD 只保留合成图。” Real human Chinese UI copy, generous image area, accurate output capabilities. Avoid giant hero headings, fabricated metrics, cards of benefits, decorative illustration, gradients and ornamental badge rows. The image panel and settings are the actual usable working interface.
